picks.title: Meditation: Basic Body Scan (20 min.)
picks.summary: In this guided body scan meditation, we explore a simple and nourishing pathway into presence—awakening awareness through the living sensations of the body. Beginning with a gentle softening of the eyes, face and shoulders, we gradually move awareness through the hands, heart, belly, legs and feet, sensing the aliveness that is already here. As the meditation unfolds, we widen our attention to experience the whole body as a field of sensation, allowing the breath and this moment to be just as they are. picks.reason: Guided body scan meditation cultivating presence and awareness of sensations.

picks.title: Ep. 1054 - (Group Learning Program) - Guided Breathing Mindfulness Meditation
picks.summary: (Group Learning Program) - Guided Breathing Mindfulness MeditationBreathing Mindfulness Meditation was the primary form of meditation employed by The Buddha to attain Enlightenment. There are many aspects of The Path to Enlightenment that one would need to learn and practice with guidance from a Teacher, however, Breathing Mindfulness Meditation should be among the top priorities for any Practitioner aspiring to attain Enlightenment.The goal of Breathing Mindfulness Meditation is to develop “Right Mindfulness”, “Right Concentration”, and to eliminate the unwholesome root of craving/desire/atta
picks.reason: Guided breathing meditation central to the Buddha's path to enlightenment.
